title: Continental road bicycle tires (United States)
notes: US road-tire range read 2026-11-01: Grand Prix 5000 S TR, 5000 TT TR, Aero 111, 5000 AS TR, Grand Prix 5000, Grand Prix TR, Grand Prix, Ultra Sport, Grand Sport, Grand Prix 4-Season, Gatorskin, Gatorskin Black Edition and two tubulars, plus Pogacar and TdF limited editions. Sold through retailers; the site has a retailer locator and no direct shop.
